title: Planning run test decomposition
description: Objective: split the oversized planning-run reducer test without weakening its behavioral proof. Deliverable: packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-test-fixtures.ts owns deterministic hashes/witness/state/command/error helpers; planning-run-reducer.test.ts retains creation, readiness, ownership, proposal, and submission-finalization coverage; new planning-run-authority.test.ts owns approval, activation, cancellation, concurrency, version-ceiling, and exhaustive lifecycle coverage. Hard dependency: commit bcdc2f6 and the stable planning-contract.js facade. NOT in scope: production edits, new behavior, renamed/skipped cases, or reduced assertions. Owned paths: packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-reducer.test.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-test-fixtures.ts, packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-authority.test.ts. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test.
definitionOfDone: Every existing planning-run test case and assertion is preserved exactly once across the two test files; no skip/only/todo or assertion loosening is introduced.
The shared fixture module contains only deterministic test construction/assertion helpers and exports no production API.
All three files are <=250 physical lines and test ordering does not create shared mutable state.
The focused core typecheck and test command exits 0 with production files unchanged.
taskRails: Refactor-only: preserve public types, stable error codes, check precedence, event/result ordering, deep freezing, and all observable reducer behavior.
Do not weaken, skip, rename, or delete behavioral assertions merely to make the split pass.
Every changed or new production/test TypeScript file in this task must be <=250 physical lines with LF/CRLF counted equivalently.
Use TDD/characterization and commit only explicit owned paths; no worktree, broad add, push, merge, reset, or stash.

implementationPlan.description: Characterization baseline (read-only): planning-run-reducer.test.ts is 514 lines with 32 it() cases; fixture surface = lines 18-153 (hash() + the ~20 frozen witness/command constants PLAN_HASH..CANCELLATION, summaries(), finalizeWitness(), SEALED, state(), commandFor(), expectError(), expectIllegal(), accepted()); describe blocks partition cleanly on the task's named boundary — 'creation and readiness' + 'ownership' + proposal/submission blocks stay, approval/activation/cancellation/concurrency/version-ceiling/exhaustive-lifecycle blocks move. Record the EXACT baseline: `git show HEAD:packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-reducer.test.ts | grep -c "it("` (=32) and the full it()-name list to a scratchpad file OUTSIDE the repo (auto-commit sweep) — this is the preserved-exactly-once oracle. Fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test` GREEN before starting; note the planning-run suite's current pass count.

Extract packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-test-fixtures.ts BY RANGE: move lines 18-153 verbatim (hash helper, all frozen constants, summaries/finalizeWitness/SEALED, state/commandFor factories, expectError/expectIllegal/accepted assertion helpers) with exactly their current imports (expect from vitest stays importable in a fixtures module — the assertion helpers call expect; that is test-infrastructure, legal in a *.ts non-test file under the root vitest run since it is only ever imported FROM test files); export every moved symbol; `import type` for the contract types; NodeNext '.js' specifiers. RAIL CHECK: the module contains ONLY deterministic construction/assertion helpers — no production API re-exports (DoD 2); no Date/random (hash() is deterministic seed-based — verify verbatim). File lands ~140 lines.

Split the 32 cases across the two test files on the task's named partition, moving describe blocks VERBATIM: planning-run-reducer.test.ts KEEPS creation, readiness, ownership, proposal, and submission-finalization coverage (imports fixtures via './planning-run-test-fixtures.js'); NEW planning-run-authority.test.ts takes approval, activation, cancellation, concurrency, version-ceiling, and exhaustive-lifecycle coverage (same fixture imports). ZERO case bodies edited; ZERO renamed/skip/only/todo; matrix/derived case sets (exhaustive lifecycle loops over SEALED etc.) move with their derivation intact. ORDERING INDEPENDENCE (DoD 3): fixtures are frozen constants + pure factories — no module-level mutable state; each file's suites run standalone (`pnpm exec vitest run --root ../.. packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-authority.test.ts` green in isolation, same for the trimmed original). All three files <=250 physical lines (expect ~190 / ~140 / ~230).

Verification gate + preserved-exactly-once audit: (1) `wc -l` all three files — each <=250 (LF/CRLF equivalently); (2) case audit — combined `grep -c "it("` across both test files === 32 AND the sorted it()-name multiset equals the step-1 baseline list exactly (no loss, no duplication, no rename — the DoD-1 oracle); grep for skip|only|todo -> zero; (3) fresh `pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test` -> exit 0 with production files untouched (`git status --porcelain -- packages/core/src/planning` shows only the three owned test/fixture paths) — complete_task evidence: { command: "pnpm --filter @moe/core typecheck && pnpm --filter @moe/core test", exitCode: 0, outputTail }; total planning-run assertions pass count unchanged vs baseline; (4) isolation runs of each test file individually -> green; (5) repo gate with foreign-red attribution; run twice — identical.

Adversarial self-review + explicit-pathspec commit. Load Skill adversarial-self-review. Extra: (a) verbatim-move diff — each moved describe block and fixture body identical to the HEAD baseline (assertion strings, error-code expectations, matrix derivations untouched); (b) fixtures module exports no production symbol (grep its exports against packages/core/src/index.ts exports — zero overlap); (c) delete the scratchpad baseline file (it lives outside the repo — confirm nothing strayed under the tree; auto-commit sweep); (d) no shared mutable state — grep fixtures for `let`/mutation -> zero. Commit per epic rail 3: `git status --porcelain`, unstage foreign paths, `git add` + `git commit -- packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-reducer.test.ts packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-test-fixtures.ts packages/core/src/planning/planning-run-authority.test.ts`; `git show --stat` lists exactly these 3 paths.

reopenReason: Governor: dependency satisfied — commit bcdc2f6 is landed. Third of the five decomposition children required by the approved size exception (prop-2eaa632d). Splits planning-run-reducer.test.ts and extracts planning-run-test-fixtures.ts. Note the exception explicitly covers TEST files too — the <=250-line rule is not production-only.

planningNotes.approachesConsidered: Partition is pre-named by the task and matches the file's existing describe structure (verified: 32 it() cases; fixture surface is a clean 18-153 range of frozen constants + pure factories + assertion helpers). Alternatives (three-way test split, per-lifecycle files) rejected: the named two-file partition lands all three files comfortably under 250 (~190/~140/~230) and keeps the exhaustive-lifecycle matrix in one place with its derivation. Assertion helpers calling vitest expect stay in the fixtures module — legal test infrastructure (only ever imported from test files; root vitest include only matches *.test.ts so the fixtures module itself never runs as a suite). No verification workflow: trivial-class refactor, partition pre-named, preserved-exactly-once enforced by a mechanical it()-name multiset audit against the HEAD baseline.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights: planning-run-reducer.test.ts = 514 lines / 32 cases; fixture range 18-153 (hash(), ~20 frozen witness/command constants, summaries/finalizeWitness/SEALED, state/commandFor factories, expectError/expectIllegal/accepted helpers — all deterministic, no Date/random, no module-level mutable state, so ordering independence is by construction); describe blocks: 'creation and readiness', 'ownership', proposal/submission blocks (STAY) vs approval/activation/cancellation/concurrency/version-ceiling/exhaustive-lifecycle (MOVE). Root vitest include packages/**/*.test.ts — the new authority test file is auto-discovered; the fixtures .ts (non-.test) is never collected as a suite. Production files untouched (rail); root index frozen.
planningNotes.risks: (1) Case loss/duplication is THE failure mode — the it()-name multiset audit vs the HEAD baseline is mechanical and non-negotiable; grep skip|only|todo zero. (2) Matrix derivations (loops over SEALED etc.) must move with their loops intact — a hand-unrolled copy would silently drop cases while keeping counts plausible; the audit counts NAMES, and derived names must match too. (3) Fixtures exporting anything production-shaped violates DoD 2 — export-overlap grep. (4) Baseline scratch file must live OUTSIDE the repo (wrapper auto-commit sweep). (5) Shared tree: three-path explicit commit; foreign-red attribution.
